name: TenantCloud
description: TenantCloud is a cloud property management platform built for DIY landlords, featuring online rent collection, tenant screening, maintenance tracking, and Schedule E accounting.
best_for: DIY landlords, independent real estate investors, and small property managers seeking affordable rental management.
features: Online rent collection with automatic late fees and payment reminders
Syndicated rental listings on major rental portals (Zillow, Trulia, HotPads)
Built-in tenant screening powered by TransUnion (credit, background, eviction)
E-signature lease agreements with state-specific legal templates
Maintenance request management with tenant photo uploads and expense logging
Basic landlord accounting and Schedule E tax reporting

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Core rent collection, listings, and tenant screening.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Adds owner portal, QuickBooks sync, and lease builder.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Adds vendor network and maintenance bidding.

pros: Very budget-friendly starting price for landlords with small-to-medium portfolios
Clean automated rent collection and tenant screening workflow
Comprehensive mobile apps for both landlords and tenants
cons: QuickBooks integration requires the Growth tier ($32/mo)
Customer support response times can be slower on the entry Starter tier
Less suited for large commercial or multi-family enterprise portfolios (100+ units)

alternatives.name: DoorLoop
alternatives.description: Modern all-in-one property management software with comprehensive accounting and owner portals.
alternatives.best_for: Growing landlords wanting a premium modern interface

alternatives.name: AppFolio
alternatives.description: Enterprise property management platform with AI leasing and multi-family management.

alternatives.name: Buildium
alternatives.description: Residential and community association property management platform.
